plans.idea: Centered top-to-bottom story like the original: logo, big bottle, a wide text block with readable headline and flavour names, then the Build Your Pack / Online Only badge row, with the two extra bottles as a small centered strip at the bottom.

Product lineup band: the hero bottle on the left with the two smaller bottles beside it so they read as a set of three, the full copy block below on the full width, and the badge row anchored at the bottom as the call to action.

Editorial two-column layout: logo top-left over a tall left text column (headline first, then the flavour list and copy), the products stacked in a right column that shares the same top edge, and a full-width badge bar closing the page.
